text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty triggered: HIGH - 5xx spike in /v1/generate (prefix cache layer). See alert: <https://alerts.redwood.example/INC-20765>

alex: got pager, jumping in. seeing surge in 502/504, target latency >5s.

maria: checking kv-metrics, shard 7 shows eviction rate +380% over baseline. checksum mismatch spikes on shard heal logs.

lee: I see logs: `prefix_cache::verify_checksum failed for key=usr-12345 seq=9876` repeated, then subsequent reads fallback to backend causing timeouts.

james: reproducer indicates a compaction job ran ~2076543200 and may have left partial index. Could be corrupt manifests.

sarah: customer-impact: CS reports 12 customers with elevated errors, 3 with timeouts causing 503s at edge.

alex: immediate mitigation idea: disable KV prefix prefetch on shard 7 to avoid repeated checksum verifies + fallback storm. Can we toggle via runtime flag? :zap:

infra-bot: Runtime flag `prefetch.enabled.shard.7=false` applied via rollout=fast to shard=7 (config-service). Propagation ~5s.

maria: rolling back prefetch on that shard now. Monitoring error rate.

(30s later)

lee: errors dropped ~45% in last minute, but some 5xx remain from gateway timeouts awaiting backend reads.

james: start increasing circuit breaker threshold to short-circuit long backend reads for that shard.

sarah: notifying product & support. Started message to affected customers with workaround note. Ticket #INC-20765 created.

alex: new plan: run checksum-verify for shard 7 in read-only, if mismatch detected, mark keys as 'stale' to avoid heavy repair. Maria, can you run `kv-check --shard 7 --verify-only --limit 5000`?

maria: running it now, streaming results.

```
2026-03-15T14:40:12Z INFO verify key=usr-12345 ok
2026-03-15T14:40:12Z WARN verify key=usr-67890 checksum_mismatch
2026-03-15T14:40:13Z WARN verify key=usr-11121 checksum_mismatch
```

maria: found ~120 mismatches in first 5k. Skipping auto-repair to avoid write amplification.

lee: recommendation: patch runtime to treat checksum_mismatch as 'serve-from-origin-disable-prefetch' so we don't cause mass backend readbacks. Can push a small config or hotfix.

alex: I can deploy hotfix to route mismatched keys to a degraded read path that serves stale but validated entries, reducing backend load. Need +1 from infra for quick deploy window.

infra-bot: emergency deploy window approved for 2076543260-2076543320. CI gating relaxed with manual monitor.

james: prepping PR with the fallback handler. Will include extra metrics for 'served_stale' and 'mismatch_count'.

(deploy)

support-bot: internal note: CS updated affected customers — we promised a follow-up once fully mitigated.

(5m later)

alex: hotfix deployed, shard-level prefetch still disabled. 5xx rate back to baseline, tail latency improved. Marking live mitigation success.

sarah: handing off to oncall-night (lee) for verification and postmortem capture. oncall-night please take over at 14:55 UTC.

lee: taking over the handoff. Will prepare timeline, root-cause hypothesis: compaction left inconsistent manifests -> checksum drift -> prefetch verify caused cascade of backend fallbacks -> eviction/miss storm -> gateway timeouts.

lee: actions for postmortem: 1) full kv-check on shard 7 2) fix compaction idempotency 3) add guard to prefetch to skip on high verify-failure rates 4) customer outreach template

alex: tagging for SRE review and prioritization.

incident-bot: Incident severity -> Major. Handoff from alex to lee at 2076543255. Pager cleared for MITIGATION.
